blocks: ## D3 - the note to the asker (FR-004)

decisions.id: Summary: two page sessions then the note
decisions.summary: One write page session, one check-and-apply session, then a note to the asker; no code, map or canon change.
decisions.why: The request's work (the four questions' leads) and FR-004/FR-005 as written; how sessions are split decides nothing the request set.

decisions.summary: 類聚近世風俗志 上 (991466) and the 1934 edition (1444386) by full-text search; 下 (991467) page by page in NDL's viewer or through 1444386 once shown whole.
decisions.why: Exactly the routes the request names: full-text for 991466 and 1444386, 991467 'only in the viewer'.

decisions.summary: 'unread lead' if 下 (991467) cannot be searched.
decisions.why: The request already states 991467 cannot be full-text searched and is readable in the viewer, and that the 守貞謾稿 leads 'are searched in this feature, not called SILENT'. A fallback triggered by 'cannot be searched' is triggered by a condition the request says is already true, so read literally it lets 下 end as an unread lead on day one, which guts the clause. Only physical impossibility of the route the request names is legitimate: reword to 'unread lead only if NDL's viewer refuses 991467 (dated, as observed) and 1444386 is not shown to hold 下 whole'.

decisions.summary: page-session briefs; the passes are leads, each passage read on its page; NDL scans and Oishi's PDF read on rendered page images sent to source-reader with IMAGES=.
decisions.why: Method for carrying the found figures (FR-001, FR-002 'from a passage read on its page'); narrows nothing asked.

decisions.summary: Each new figure set beside the same place-and-period craftsman and laborer day wage, or that wage SILENT with the nearest named (class, place, unit, gap).
decisions.why: Adds rigor to the figures the request asks for; does not drop any lead or verdict.

decisions.summary: No generator change, so no bookends.
decisions.why: FR-005: no engine or map change.

decisions.summary: XII research: physical per question task; XIII record checks green; XVI built as the spec's FRs.
decisions.why: Restates gates; decides nothing the spec left open.

decisions.summary: Kyoto carpenter 1653 (Hirai 2007), the 1656 bath account as arithmetic, Osaka laborers 1620s (Kitano) beside Mimasaka 1665.
decisions.why: The request's FOUND line for 0276.

decisions.summary: 'Mimasaka SILENT after 藩法集 岡山藩 is read or named.'
decisions.why: The request names the 賃銀雑事 chapter as 'a Mimasaka/Okayama wage' to be read if public, i.e. the wage sought for that slot. The row writes the verdict SILENT whatever the chapter says, deciding the outcome before the reading on an unmeasured premise (that an Okayama figure cannot serve); 'Okayama is not Mimasaka' is an accuracy argument, which does not legitimate a carve-out. Reword: 'Mimasaka/Okayama: the 賃銀雑事 chapter's wage beside 1665 if it is public and gives one; SILENT naming it if it gives none; named unread if not public.'

decisions.summary: Inui named not readable; sharpener: Morisada's 磨師 entry (trade, no fee) and Uwajima 1662 (swords only).
decisions.why: The request's SILENT line for the sharpener's fee and its closed-lead list for Inui.

decisions.summary: An Edo craftsman/laborer pair from 類聚近世風俗志, searched in NDL's viewer and full-text search, or SILENT naming the search.
decisions.why: The request's 'pp. 159-161 may give an Edo carpenter' lead, searched by the routes it names; SILENT only after the search, which the request permits.

decisions.summary: Oishi's yearly table 1781-1842 (low and high mon per ryo), decade summaries as arithmetic, Edo-ness the record's reading; 1842-52 blank; 1850s SILENT; restricted 両替年代記 books and 新保 1978 named; 読史備要 1780s rows if read.
decisions.why: The request's FOUND line and closed-lead list for 0277; the blank and SILENT spans are the honest edges of the table the request names; 読史備要 is optional extra, cutting nothing asked.

decisions.summary: Edo Ako salt brokers' 1791 price with the bale's measure as read, per-sho arithmetic; Edo retail and 1800-1850s from the Morisada search or SILENT naming it; wholesalers' commission if read.
decisions.why: The request's FOUND line for 0273 and its 'Morisada for Edo salt ... searched, not called SILENT'.

decisions.summary: Only the anchor rows of 0277 and the wage sections of 0273 and 0276 the new figures touch are revised; nothing else in the three pages changes.
decisions.why: Confines edits to what the leads change; the request asks for nothing else on those pages.

decisions.summary: implementation-check.md: one 'no code implements it - consumed by gm-assistant's money skill' line per changed question, with the search.
decisions.why: FR-003 as written.

decisions.summary: A new issue on EliAndrewC/diagram or a comment on #8, naming changed fragment files, each verdict changed from the #5 and #8 answers, the closed leads, and what is still open including feature 403's leads.
decisions.why: FR-004 says 'on GitHub' and lists the content; the note covers #5's changed verdicts as well as #8's.

decisions.summary: Order: page sessions, implementation check, note, report and land by the direct route.
decisions.why: Sequencing only.

blocks: ## D3 - the note to the asker (FR-004)

decisions.summary: One write page session, one check-and-apply session, then the note; no code, map or canon change.
decisions.why: Process shape for the four questions the request names; the no-code line is FR-005.

decisions.summary: Full-text search 上 (991466) and the 1934 edition (1444386); read 下 (991467) page by page in NDL's viewer, or via 1444386 once shown whole.
decisions.why: Exactly the routes request.md names: full-text for 991466 and 1444386, 991467 only in the viewer.

decisions.summary: 下 is an unread lead ONLY if NDL's viewer refuses 991467 (dated, as observed) and 1444386 is not shown to hold 下 whole.
decisions.why: Round 1's fallback triggered on 'cannot be searched', which the request had already said was true of 991467 (viewer only) and so let the viewer reading be skipped. The rewrite triggers only when both routes the request names are physically refused, recorded with date and observation; reading a book the server refuses is physically impossible, and naming it unread (not SILENT) keeps the request's 'not called SILENT'.

decisions.summary: Passes are leads; each passage read on its page; NDL scans and Oishi's PDF read on page images, sent to source-reader with IMAGES=.
decisions.why: FR-001 'each from a passage read on its page'; method only.

decisions.summary: Each new figure sits beside the craftsman's and laborer's day wage of the same place and period, or the wage is SILENT naming the nearest with class, place, unit and gap.
decisions.why: Serves the request's first lead (a day wage beside the 1665 knife ceiling) and the money answers' standing form; adds no exclusion.

decisions.summary: No performance bookends: no generator change.
decisions.why: FR-005: no engine code changes.

decisions.summary: XII research: physical tasks; XIII record checks green; XVI built as the FRs.
decisions.why: Standing gates; narrows nothing.

decisions.summary: Kyoto carpenter 1653, 1656 bath account (arithmetic), Osaka laborers 1620s beside Mimasaka 1665.
decisions.why: The FOUND result of the request's first lead.

decisions.summary: 藩法集 岡山藩 賃銀雑事: its wage beside 1665 if public and it gives one; SILENT naming it if it gives none; named unread if not public.
decisions.why: Round 1 fixed SILENT regardless of the chapter; the rewrite follows the request's 'read if public, or named unread' with the outcome decided by the reading.

decisions.summary: Inui named not readable; sharpener: Morisada's 磨師 entry (no fee), Uwajima 1662 (swords only).
decisions.why: The request records both as the passes' result (SILENT; Inui not public).

decisions.summary: An Edo craftsman/laborer pair from 類聚近世風俗志 searched in viewer and full-text, or SILENT naming the search.
decisions.why: The request: 'pp. 159-161 may give an Edo carpenter' is searched in this feature, not called SILENT; SILENT only after the search, named.

decisions.summary: Oishi's yearly table 1781-1842 low/high mon per ryo, decade summaries as arithmetic, Edo-ness the record's reading; 1842-52 blank; 1850s SILENT; restricted 両替年代記 books and 新保 1978 named; 読史備要 1780s rows if read.
decisions.why: The FOUND result and the closed leads exactly as the request lists them; the 1850s were not found by any pass and the request names no further lead for them; 読史備要 is an extra, optional source, not a dropped one.

decisions.summary: Ako salt brokers' 1791 price, 9-9.5 bales per ryo, bale measure as read, per-sho arithmetic; Edo retail and 1800-1850s from the Morisada search or SILENT naming it; commission if read.
decisions.why: The request's FOUND item plus 'Morisada for Edo salt' searched, not called SILENT; the commission is not in the request and is optional.

decisions.summary: Only 0277's anchor rows and the touched wage sections of 0273/0276 are revised; nothing else on those pages changes.
decisions.why: The request asks for these leads written in, nothing more; the limit trims nothing the request named.

decisions.summary: implementation-check.md: one 'no code implements it' line per changed question, with the search.
decisions.why: FR-003 as written.

decisions.summary: A new issue or a comment on #8 naming changed fragment files, changed verdicts, closed leads, and what is still open including 403's leads.
decisions.why: FR-004 as written; the still-open list is the request's own '403' section.

decisions.summary: Page sessions, implementation check, note, report and land by the direct route.
decisions.why: Ordering only.
